research_scope: Five early/base-game skills from PQ24-PQ28 selected after live repository duplicate checks. Quest identity and core mechanics are corroborated; unsupported reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish requirements remain unresolved.

records.name: Double Death Slicer
records.skill_description: Creates two Death Slicers that can be repeatedly directed toward the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Skill-specific data identifies Double Death Slicer as a 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. It creates two discs, and repeat inputs can make them track the opponent. Each documented hit deals 10% damage. PQ24 reward lists identify the skill. Player reports indicate the skill is associated with the Ultimate Finish, but the exact canonical reward-slot condition remains unresolved.

records.name: Spirit Explosion
records.skill_description: A close-range explosive Strike Ultimate associated with the Emperor's Brother quest.
records.mechanics_notes: The independent PQ reward transcription and current Xenoverse 2 skill guide place Spirit Explosion in PQ25. The canonical classification is Strike Ultimate; exact hit count, damage, reward-slot semantics and Ultimate-Finish requirement remain unresolved.

records.name: Crazy Finger Shot
records.skill_description: Fires a thin finger beam, with additional inputs extending the barrage.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data identifies Crazy Finger Shot as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. Holding/continuing the input can produce up to 14 blasts, using up to 800 Ki in total, with 40% documented total damage. PQ26 reward lists independently identify the quest source.

records.name: Sauzer Blade
records.skill_description: A blade-based Strike Super associated with Sauzer and the Metal Cooler quest.
records.mechanics_notes: Independent PQ reward transcriptions place Sauzer Blade in PQ27, and the current Xenoverse 2 skill guide indexes it under PQ27. Exact Ki cost, damage, hit count, CaC restrictions and reward-slot semantics remain unresolved pending stronger skill-specific evidence.

records.name: Spread Shot Retreat
records.skill_description: An evasive maneuver that retreats while firing a spread of projectiles.
records.mechanics_notes: The independent PQ reward transcription and current Xenoverse 2 skill guide place Spread Shot Retreat in PQ28. It is classified as an Evasive skill. The maintained skill-data transcription lists a 200-stamina cost; exact damage, invulnerability behavior and reward-slot semantics remain unresolved.
